data.title: Mbappe and Real face long road to redemption in China
data.description: HONG KONG - Kylian Mbappe, Real Madrid and La Liga have apologised for the superstar striker’s comments about Mao Zedong, but the damage to their reputation in China won’t be easily or quickly repaired, experts say.

data.title: ONE Championship: Chatri confirms Di Bella title defence for ONE 174 in December
data.description: Jonathan Di Bella will defend his ONE Championship strawweight kickboxing title at ONE 174 in December, as the promotion revives its numbered series even sooner than March’s planned return to Qatar.

data.title: Antonelli ready to rewrite F1 record books in Mexico
data.description: MEXICO CITY - Kimi Antonelli will take his place in Formula One’s record books as the youngest champion and Italy’s first since 1953, barring a wild swing of unexpected misfortunes amid a fiesta atmosphere at this weekend’s Mexico City Grand Prix.

data.title: Mbappe furore rages on in China, but Mao comments censored
data.description: BEIJING — Kylian Mbappe struggled to dissipate anger on Chinese social media on Wednesday despite apologising for his comments on Mao Zedong that cost him several commercial deals in the huge market.

data.title: Tony Jacklin: A legend on and off the course
data.description: My paths first crossed with Tony Jacklin when I skipped school at just 12 years old and went up to London to see the then Ryder Cup team practise before heading off to the US. At 23, he was just starting out his career and I could see several of the older established players were wondering just who the young upstart was.

data.title: Arsenal stunned by fourth-tier Fleetwood in League Cup
data.description: FLEETWOOD (UNITED KINGDOM) - Arsenal suffered one of the most humiliating defeats in their history as the Premier League champions were stunned by fourth-tier minnows Fleetwood in a League Cup penalty shoot-out on Tuesday.

data.title: Russia back, Thai spikers draw United States test
data.description: Thailand will face five-time world champions the United States in the pool stage of the 2027 FIVB Women's Volleyball World Cup as the draw for the championship was unveiled on Monday night.

data.title: Unrest fears prompt OCA to push back event dates
data.description: The Olympic Council of Asia (OCA) and the Local Organising Committee (LOC) of the 6th Asian Indoor and Martial Arts Games Riyadh 2026 have confirmed that the Games will take place from March 28 to April 8, 2027, moving from the previously scheduled dates of Dec 11-21 this year.

data.title: Tough road ahead for War Elephants in Saudi
data.description: Thailand will begin their AFC Asian Cup 2027 campaign against two-time champions Qatar on Jan 11, four days after the tournament opens, with the Asian Football Confederation (AFC) on Tuesday confirming the kick-off times and venues for next year's competition in Saudi Arabia.

data.title: Buriram out to break a jinx
data.description: Thai League champions Buriram United will be hunting for their first win in the AFC Champions League Elite when they travel to face J1 League side Gamba Osaka in Japan Wednesday night.

data.title: Kane says Ballon d’Or win ‘feels like a dream’
data.description: LONDON - Harry Kane said Tuesday that his Ballon d’Or triumph “feels like a dream” as tributes poured in for the first English winner of the award in a generation.

data.title: Mbappe dropped by Chinese brands for 'offending national sentiments'
data.description: BEIJING — Kylian Mbappe was dropped Tuesday by two major brands in China after a video circulated online in which the French football superstar apparently joked about former leader Mao Zedong.

data.title: NBA inks deal with Kalshi and Polymarket, citing safeguards
data.description: LOS ANGELES — The National Basketball Association (NBA) on Monday announced commercial partnerships with Kalshi and Polymarket that the basketball league said will help safeguard against illegal activity on the wildly popular online prediction markets.

data.title: Kane beats Yamal and Mbappe to taste Ballon d'Or glory
data.description: LONDON - Harry Kane became England's first Ballon d'Or winner in 25 years in his native city of London on Monday, beating out stiff competition from Lamine Yamal and Kylian Mbappe.

data.title: Port have a mountain to climb in Johor
data.description: Port travel to Malaysia today seeking their first points of this season's AFC Champions League Elite, facing domestic powerhouse Johor Darul Ta'zim at Sultan Ibrahim Stadium (5pm Thai time).

data.title: Aimsaard sisters quit BAT, go solo
data.description: Women's doubles badminton players Nuntakarn Aimsaard and Benyapa Aimsaard have announced their decision to part ways with the Badminton Association of Thailand (BAT) to pursue their careers as independent athletes.

data.title: Kane tipped to beat Yamal, Mbappe to Ballon d'Or glory
data.description: LONDON - Harry Kane has been called the favourite to become England's first Ballon d'Or winner in 25 years when the award is presented in London on Monday, but he faces stiff competition from La Liga pair Lamine Yamal and Kylian Mbappe.

data.title: Kane primed to pip Yamal, Mbappe to Ballon d'Or glory
data.description: LONDON - England captain Harry Kane is the favourite to win a wide open race to be crowned Ballon d'Or winner at a glitzy London ceremony on Monday, with Lamine Yamal and Kylian Mbappe also in the running to be named the world's best footballer.

data.title: Chiefs and 49ers suffer first losses of NFL season, Vikings stay unbeaten
data.description: LOS ANGELES (UNITED STATES) - The Seattle Seahawks put on a defensive masterclass to hand the Kansas City Chiefs their first defeat of the NFL season on Sunday, winning 20-3, while the San Francisco 49ers also surrendered their perfect start to the Atlanta Falcons.

data.title: Antonelli wins US Grand Prix to close on world title
data.description: AUSTIN - Kimi Antonelli moved to within striking distance of his first world championship title as he powered to an emphatic victory at the US Grand Prix in Austin on Sunday.
